question_en:
I am creating a visual history of annual conference logos for the terms of office of successive heads of an international organization. The attachment is a cropped, text-free portion of a photo of one head. Please answer the following questions:

1. Who is the person in the image? Based on the organization's official profile page, provide one complete and concluded term of office with its start and end years.
2. Among the annual conferences held during this person's term, which conferences have logos containing at least two complete, closed circular rings that do not intersect and are nested within one another? If multiple conferences meet the condition, select the one held last. Please provide the full name of the conference, the session number, the host city, and the year.

Answer format: For Question 1, provide the person's name and the full start and end years of the term in text. For Question 2, provide the full name, session number, host city, and year of the finally selected conference in text.
answer:
Question 1: Person: Christiana Figueres; Term: 2010–2016.

Question 2: Conference: Lima Climate Change Conference - December 2014 (20th Session of the Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change and 10th Session of the Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to the Kyoto Protocol); Session: COP20 / CMP10; Host City: Lima, Peru (Lima); Year: 2014.

# Detailed Simulated Retrieval Trajectory · 8-1-B01

## Step 01 · inspect_image / Register visible clues in current input

Action: View the current final-image-real input; first record the scene structure, then establish search terms.

Evidence Observation (Archived Evidence Summary): The current input is a close-up of a short-haired person in purple clothing speaking next to a microphone; the background retains only partial character shapes, and the nameplate is not within the frame.

Result of this step: Formulated image candidate clues; the image itself does not serve as proof of external identity, term of office, awards, or release date.

## Step 02 · parse_task + search / Fix retrieval scope

Action: Divide the task into image localization, complete candidate set, item-by-item visual filtering, and hit verification; example queries: "UNFCCC former executive secretary Christiana Figueres"; "UNFCCC COP conference sessions".

Evidence Observation (Archived Evidence Summary): First confirm one complete and concluded term of office from the official profile page, then construct the full set based on annual conferences held during the actual term; visual conditions require at least two complete, closed circular rings that are disjoint and nested within one another; if multiple sessions meet the condition, select the one held most recently.

Result of this step: Expand according to the conditions in current question_zh-new; subsequently use only the corresponding subject, time range, and image version.

## Step 03 · open_page / Confirm identity using source and official term archives

Action: Locate the person based on the context of the photo published by UN Climate Change, and read the official profile page of the former UNFCCC Executive Secretary.

Evidence Observation (Archived Evidence Summary): The photo source and person data jointly point to Christiana Figueres. The complete and concluded term of office given on the official profile page is 2010–2016; the question does not require using the photo's shooting year as the start of the term.

Evidence Links:
- UNFCCC profile page: https://unfccc.int/about-us/the-executive-secretary/former-executive-secretary-ms-christiana-figueres
- Original photo page: https://www.flickr.com/photos/unfccc/6459461609/

Result of this step: Question 1 confirmed as Christiana Figueres, 2010–2016.

## Step 04 · enumerate / Intersect term with conference dates

Action: Item-by-item compare conferences within the term against the official COP conference sequence, rather than mechanically including all year-end conferences corresponding to the start and end years.

Evidence Observation (Archived Evidence Summary): The archived intersection consists of six sessions, COP16–COP21:

| Conference | City | Year |
| --- | --- | --- |
| COP16 | Cancun | 2010 |
| COP17 | Durban | 2011 |
| COP18 | Doha | 2012 |
| COP19 | Warsaw | 2013 |
| COP20 | Lima | 2014 |
| COP21 | Paris | 2015 |

COP22 in 2016 was held after this term ended, so it is not included in these six sessions.

Evidence Links:
- Official COP sequence: https://unfccc.int/process/bodies/supreme-bodies/conference-of-the-parties-cop
- 2016 conference entry (preserving sequence link): http://unfccc.int/conference/marrakech-climate-change-conference-november-2016
- Term archive: https://unfccc.int/about-us/the-executive-secretary/former-executive-secretary-ms-christiana-figueres

Result of this step: Fixed at 6 sessions; do not automatically overcount COP22 when treating 2016 as a boundary.

## Step 05 · normalize_images / Collect logos for six sessions and limit evidence

Action: Map conference names to logo images session by session; record UNFCCC conference facts separately from sources of retained event logo images from external parties.

Evidence Observation (Archived Evidence Summary): COP16 source is the event page preserved by UIC; COP17–COP21 have logos retained on research institution event series pages. This round of supplementary search extracted actual img src from these series pages, so the direct links below come from the pages themselves. The current UIC link redirects to a maintenance page and cannot restore a direct link for COP16; retain old archived pixels and their original page source, do not fabricate downloadable images.

Evidence Links:
- Original UIC logo source: https://uic.org/com/enews/nr/213/article/united-nations-climate-change
- Research institution event logo series: https://www.modelisation-prospective.org/en/events/united-nations-conferences-on-climate-change/
- COP20 official conference attachment: https://unfccc.int/resource/docs/2014/cop20/od01.pdf

Result of this step: Visual judgment for six sessions follows review of retained logos; COP17–21 provide newly extracted direct image links, while COP16 explicitly states link restoration restrictions.

## Step 06 · inspect_image / COP16 2010

Action: Trace each candidate ring around its entire circumference, sequentially confirming the three conditions: closed, disjoint, and nested inside/outside.

Evidence Observation (Archived Evidence Summary): Cancun, 2010. The tree and butterfly patterns do not contain complete nested rings meeting the requirements.

Evidence Links:
- UNFCCC conference page: http://unfccc.int/conference/cancun-climate-change-conference-november-2010
- Original logo source (currently under maintenance, cannot claim this round's image is retrievable): https://uic.org/com/enews/nr/213/article/united-nations-climate-change

Result of this step: Visually excluded.

## Step 07 · inspect_image / COP17 2011

Action: Trace each candidate ring around its entire circumference, sequentially confirming the three conditions: closed, disjoint, and nested inside/outside.

Evidence Observation (Archived Evidence Summary): Durban, 2011. The tree and globe patterns do not constitute at least two complete, closed, disjoint, nested circular rings.

Evidence Links:
- UNFCCC conference page: http://unfccc.int/conference/durban-climate-change-conference-november-2011
- Logo retention page: https://www.modelisation-prospective.org/en/events/united-nations-conferences-on-climate-change/
- Actual logo image on page (src extracted this round): https://www.modelisation-prospective.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/COP17-tree-177x142.png

Result of this step: Visually excluded.

## Step 08 · inspect_image / COP18 2012

Action: Trace each candidate ring around its entire circumference, sequentially confirming the three conditions: closed, disjoint, and nested inside/outside.

Evidence Observation (Archived Evidence Summary): Doha, 2012. The globe-like arcs have intersections; they are not two independent, complete, nested, closed circular rings.

Evidence Links:
- UNFCCC conference page: http://unfccc.int/conference/doha-climate-change-conference-november-2012
- Logo retention page: https://www.modelisation-prospective.org/en/events/united-nations-conferences-on-climate-change/
- Actual logo image on page (src extracted this round): https://www.modelisation-prospective.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/vignette_COP18-177x142.jpg

Result of this step: Visually excluded.

## Step 09 · inspect_image / COP19 2013

Action: Trace each candidate ring around its entire circumference, sequentially confirming the three conditions: closed, disjoint, and nested inside/outside.

Evidence Observation (Archived Evidence Summary): Warsaw, 2013. Multiple circular elements are arranged side-by-side; they are not one ring inside another; do not misjudge parallel rings as nested.

Evidence Links:
- UNFCCC conference page: http://unfccc.int/conference/warsaw-climate-change-conference-november-2013
- Logo retention page: https://www.modelisation-prospective.org/en/events/united-nations-conferences-on-climate-change/
- Actual logo image on page (src extracted this round): https://www.modelisation-prospective.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/COP_19_Warszawa_logo-177x142.png

Result of this step: Visually excluded.

## Step 10 · inspect_image / COP20 2014

Action: Trace each candidate ring around its entire circumference, sequentially confirming the three conditions: closed, disjoint, and nested inside/outside.

Evidence Observation (Archived Evidence Summary): Lima, 2014. Multiple complete, closed circular rings are nested layer by layer, with contours that do not intersect, satisfying the conditions.

Evidence Links:
- UNFCCC conference page: http://unfccc.int/conference/lima-climate-change-conference-december-2014
- Logo retention page: https://www.modelisation-prospective.org/en/events/united-nations-conferences-on-climate-change/
- Actual logo image on page (src extracted this round): https://www.modelisation-prospective.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/LOGO-COP20-INGLÉS-NEGRO-HORIZONTAL-640x217-1-177x142.jpg

Result of this step: Visual hit.

## Step 11 · inspect_image / COP21 2015

Action: Trace each candidate ring around its entire circumference, sequentially confirming the three conditions: closed, disjoint, and nested inside/outside.

Evidence Observation (Archived Evidence Summary): Paris, 2015. The leaf-like contours do not contain the required nested complete circular rings; although the year is later, it must still be excluded.

Evidence Links:
- UNFCCC conference page: http://unfccc.int/conference/paris-climate-change-conference-november-2015
- Logo retention page: https://www.modelisation-prospective.org/en/events/united-nations-conferences-on-climate-change/
- Actual logo image on page (src extracted this round): https://www.modelisation-prospective.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/Cop-21-177x142.jpg

Result of this step: Visually excluded.

## Step 12 · select_latest / Select the last session within the set of complete hits

Action: Sort the six session results by holding time; first check whether the later 2015 session also hits, then select the maximum year.

Evidence Observation (Archived Evidence Summary): COP20 (2014) is the only hit; COP21 (2015) is not a hit; cannot select it directly just because it is the last session within the term.

Evidence Links:
- COP20 official conference page: https://unfccc.int/conference/lima-climate-change-conference-december-2014
- COP21 official conference page: http://unfccc.int/conference/paris-climate-change-conference-november-2015

Result of this step: Final selection is COP20 / CMP10, Lima, 2014.

## Step 13 · follow_up / Confirm full conference name and combined sessions

Action: Read the official page and first-day agenda attachment of the selected conference; cross-reference the conference name, COP and CMP session numbers, and location.

Evidence Observation (Archived Evidence Summary): The official conference name is Lima Climate Change Conference - December 2014; corresponds to the 20th Session of the Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change, held jointly with the 10th Session of the Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to the Kyoto Protocol; location is Lima, Peru.

Evidence Links:
- Official conference page: https://unfccc.int/conference/lima-climate-change-conference-december-2014
- COP20 first-day agenda PDF: https://unfccc.int/resource/docs/2014/cop20/od01.pdf

Result of this step: Output full name, COP20 / CMP10, Lima, Peru, 2014.

## Step 14 · validate / Verify term of office, full set, and image logic

Action: Cross-check the list of 6 sessions, the 6 logo determinations, and the 1 final entity.

Evidence observation (archived evidence summary): All conferences during the term were reviewed; "Earth," "tree," and "multiple circle elements" are not direct grounds for a match; closed, disjoint, and nested conditions must all be satisfied simultaneously.

Result of this step: The conclusion is not affected by the current maintenance page for COP16; its original archived negative example and the image judgments for the other 5 sessions are retained.

## Step 15 · final_answer / Deliver in the format specified by the question

Action: Organize the verified identity, candidate filtering, and subsequent facts into the format specified by the question.

Evidence observation (archived evidence summary): The delivery content below is fully consistent with the current answer-new; the preceding images, webpages, and attachment links are used to re-verify each layer of filtering.

Result of this step: Deliver the verified results.

Question 1: Person: Christiana Figueres; Term: 2010–2016.

Question 2: Conference: Lima Climate Change Conference - December 2014 (20th Session of the Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change and 10th Session of the Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to the Kyoto Protocol); Session: COP20 / CMP10; Host City: Lima, Peru (Lima); Year: 2014.
